state.name: Convert video to MP4 (H.264)
state.description: Picked codec and quality with fast-start for streaming.

category.instructions: Which category best describes this hub command? Judge from state.cmd (the raw command text); state.tag and state.cli are hints only. Renders into the Details Category row, the Safety Category row, and the tag badge.

criteria.video_media: Transforms media (ffmpeg or similar): transcode, compress, extract still frames or posters, convert images; reads media inputs and writes media files
criteria.developer_workflow: Runs project scripts or package tasks (bun run, npm run, build, test, lint, dev server); effects depend on the named script
criteria.version_control: Inspects or mutates git history or branches (log, branch delete, merge helpers); operates on a repository
criteria.network_io: Sends HTTP requests (curl GET fetch or POST deploy hook); output is a response plus possible server-side effects
criteria.security_audit: Audits dependencies for vulnerabilities (npm audit); fix mode can rewrite lockfiles
criteria.container_ops: Builds container images or starts containers (docker build, docker run); changes local container state
criteria.other: Does not fit any category above

operation.instructions: What single operation does the command perform? Pick the closest match from the observable command text. Renders into the Safety Operation row with an estimated pill.

criteria.security_audit: Runs npm audit over installed packages, with or without fix
criteria.media_transcode: Re-encodes video with a picked codec and quality level (ffmpeg with -crf or a codec flag)
criteria.frame_extract: Grabs a single still frame from a video (ffmpeg with -vframes 1)
criteria.media_convert_generic: Transforms media with ffmpeg but matches none of the specific media patterns above
criteria.container_build: Builds a container image from the working directory (docker build)
criteria.container_run: Starts a container from an image (docker run)
criteria.history_read: Only reads commit history (git log); changes nothing
criteria.branch_delete: Deletes local branches already merged into main (git branch -d, possibly via xargs)
criteria.network_post: Sends an HTTP POST that can trigger side effects server-side (curl with -X POST)
criteria.network_get: Sends an HTTP GET and prints the response (plain curl fetch)
criteria.script_run: Runs a project script (bun run or npm run); effects depend on that script
criteria.other_general: A general task matching none of the operations above; falls back to the hub category

produces.instructions: What does running the command with example values produce? Look for output files, destinations, or response patterns in state.cmd. Renders into the Safety Produces row with an estimated pill.

criteria.image_file: Extracts a still frame to an image file (-vframes 1, poster output)
criteria.output_file: References an output file or destination that is created or overwritten (input.output, -o flag, shell redirect)
criteria.container_image: Builds a tagged container image (docker build)
criteria.remote_effects_with_response: POST changes server state and returns a response
criteria.stdout_response_only: GET prints the response without writing files
criteria.readonly_terminal_output: Prints history or findings; writes nothing (git log without delete, audit without fix)
criteria.dependency_rewrite: Audit in fix mode can rewrite dependencies and lockfiles
criteria.unknown: No output file, destination, or response pattern detected in the command text

risk.instructions: How destructive is this command if run with example values? Return the severity level. Renders into the Safety How destructive row as a Low/Medium/High pill plus reasons.
criteria: Low: read-only, or writes only new output files; deletes nothing and confirms nothing automatically
Medium: auto-confirms overwrites (-y, --force), triggers remote side effects (POST), builds or starts containers, or rewrites dependencies (audit fix)
High: deletes data (rm -rf, git branch -d, xargs with -d)

mutates_files.instructions: Does the command write or change files, images, containers, lockfiles, or remote state? Renders into the Safety Mutates files Yes/No row.

criteria.true: Writes or changes files, images, containers, lockfiles, or remote state (output refs, -o, docker build/run, -vframes, movflags, crf, POST, audit fix, branch -d)
criteria.false: Read-only; writes nothing (history inspection, plain GET, audit without fix)

deletes_data.instructions: Does the command delete files or branches? Renders into the Safety Deletes files Yes/No row.

criteria.true: Deletes branches or files matched by the command (rm, git branch -d, xargs with -d, delete)

overwrites_files.instructions: Could existing files be replaced without asking? Renders into the Safety Overwrites files Yes/No row.

criteria.true: Possible: auto-confirm flags (-y, --force), media output extensions, output refs, -o, shell redirect, POST, or audit fix
criteria.false: No overwrite detected in the command text
